headline: Itaú Unibanco registers crypto brokerage operations with Central Bank of Brazil
summary: Itaú Unibanco, Brazil's largest private lender, formally notified the central bank of its crypto trading and custody operations, becoming the first bank to formalize under new regulations.
why: Itaú Unibanco is Latin America's largest bank, and its formal entry into digital asset custody sets a benchmark for mainstream financial institution adoption in the region.

impacts.name: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A.
impacts.why: Formalizing regulated digital asset services allows the lender to expand fee revenue streams from retail and institutional clients.
